allowed_interpretation: The aggregate mean degradation is statistically inconclusive because the bootstrap CI crosses zero.
forbidden_rationale: Failure to establish a mean degradation is NOT the same as evidence of quality equivalence / non-inferiority. The CI crossing zero only means the mean effect is not resolvable from zero at 95% confidence; it does not license a claim of no systematic effect, and it does not establish non-inferiority (see QUALITY0R_NONINFERIORITY).

distinction.note: These are NOT equivalent. Non-inferiority is a pre-registered gate question (see QUALITY0R_NONINFERIORITY); the mean CI is an inference question.
